Source: https://github.com/CreunaFI/color-space-fixer (icc/sRGB2014.icc,
icc/LICENSE.txt), itself redistributing the standard ICC-published sRGB
v2 profile (the 2014-corrigendum "sRGB2014.icc" build). Verified
structurally correct on vendoring: 3024-byte 'mntr'/'RGB '/'XYZ ' ICC
profile with a valid 'acsp' signature.
